ValidationRule.description: Ensures that Downstream Partner Accounts have an assigned Advantage Program Tier before proceeding
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Downstream_Reseller__c)), ISCHANGED(Downstream_Reseller__c), ISPICKVAL( Downstream_Reseller__r.Partner_Level__c, ""), NOT($Permission.DisableValidationRules) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The selected Downstream Partner must have an Advantage Program Tier assigned.
